newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Murdoch's News Corp reports strong profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Murdoch's News Corp reports strong profit rise.

text.p: Rupert Murdoch's global media conglomerate News Corp Ltd posted a healthy rise in third-quarter profits on Thursday, boosted by surging returns from its British and U.S. television and film operations.

News Corp, based in Australia but also listed in London and New York, said net profit before abnormal items for the three months to March 31 had risen to A$376 million (US$293 million) from A$281 million, a rise of around 34 percent.
Net profits after abnormals were A$330 million, up from A$77 million in the same period last year.
The driving force behind the rise was News Corp's Fox Television and Fox Films and its successful re-release of the updated Star Wars movie trilogy.

News said British newspapers and satellite television unit BSkyB also produced significant profit contributions. News' book publishing and Australasian newspaper and pay television were the main drags on profit, the group said.

Murdoch last year predicted that News could achieve a 20 percent profit rise for the year, a forecast that was not borne out by first-half results. Thursday's figures put the group back on track to achieve that rise.
